lines.2: 「Still, not bad. Over 10,000 yen for one day of playing security guard.」
lines.3: 「Yeah. We need to save up so we don't wind up broke when summer vacation comes.」
lines.4: This was how we steadily built up our savings.
lines.5: This daily grind was what let us afford to eat out and go have fun.
lines.6: 「Ow. The injuries from those martial arts club guys yesterday still hurt.」
lines.7: 「I heard they made you grovel on your knees at their dojo.」
lines.8: 「Pathetic. No matter what happened, I'd never bow my head.」
lines.9: 「Hah. Big talk from you. You're all mouth half the time.」
lines.10: 「Anyway, I'm going home. I'm getting sleepy.」
lines.12: I smacked Crab awake after finding her fast asleep in my bed and shooed her out. At last, my room was quiet.
lines.15: But I still had to take a bath.
lines.16: A bath would wake me up.
